verdict.rationale: Jina Reader can extract specific fields, but it does so through LLM-driven extraction (the `x-json-schema` or `x-instruction` headers with ReaderLM-v2), not deterministic CSS/XPath rules. The only CSS selector in evidence is `x-wait-for-selector`, which controls when the page is ready rather than what content is extracted. Missing for 10: CSS selector-based field extraction, XPath support, any documented selector-rule extraction header, hands-on corroboration.
